$comment: The tool->tool import graph as it stood when the layering rule arrived (WP0, 2026-10-03, tree 923349423), resolved the way tools/tests/lib/test_layering.py resolves imports. It only shrinks: a new edge fails the test, and so does a listed edge whose files exist but no longer import; `python tools/tests/lib/test_layering.py --prune` drops stale and deleted edges and never adds one. A file split carries the moved code's edges and nothing else (WP3a: `datagap -> dataclosure`, and `dataclosure -> callers/poolseams` in place of datagap's own; that batch's net is -4). WP5 split mwlink_debugger.py into the package tools/mwlink/ (imports inside one package are not edges, test_layering.package_of) and left the shim's one edge `mwlink_debugger.py -> mwlink/cli.py`, retired with the shim in WP6; the PE reader moved to lib.binary.pe, dropping `pass_points -> dissect`: that batch's net is 0. WP3c put the seam rules in tools/splits/seams/evidence.py (five entry points import it), split splitcheck into the package tools/splits/invariants/ (one edge, `splitcheck.py -> invariants/audit.py`) and moved the callers query into lib.refs (accessextent, dataclaim, dataclosure stop importing callers): that batch's net is -12. WP3e moved the lane model into lib.lanes (claims, slots, lane, rescue, wtsafe, queue, lanecmd, worktreehook delegate to it) and split brief.py into tools/units/briefing/ (sources is the one module that reads other tools): the split carries brief.py's dossier/handoff/langcheck/typeregistry edges to briefing/sources.py and adds brief.py -> briefing/__init__.py; that batch drops 24 edges and adds 5, net -19. WP3d split stylelint.py into the package tools/units/stylelint_rules/ and swapped its two edges (`stylelint.py -> datagap.py` became `stylelint_rules/diff.py -> dataclosure.py`, where the fold map lives; `stylelint.py -> mangle.py` became lib.names) for the shim's one edge `stylelint.py -> stylelint_rules/api.py`; with the symbols/source-scanner delegations that batch's net is -13. WP4 split land.py into the package tools/units/landing/: land.py's 14 edges become the package's 11 (each foreign tool imported by one module) plus the shim's `land.py -> landing/api.py`; the subproc/unitutil/recompile edges went to lib (net -2). WP6 deleted the shims unitutil, unionguard, unionresolve, unionprose, checklf, relocaudit, sharedfiles, subproc, spawnretry, freshguard, reportdiff: their edges went with them, and landing/branch.py's two edges to the deleted union shims now name the package modules they forwarded to (tools/units/merge/unionguard.py, unionresolve.py). WP6: test code is not an importer (a legacy *_selftest.py, as tools/tests/ already was) and a tool's own <stem>_selftest.py is not an edge (one tested unit): 58 edges; flipcheck and vtslot take norm_unit from lib.lanes.naming and dataclaim/dataqueue the section order from lib.project.splits: 3 more; 141 -> 80 edges, and every edge now states its reason.
